agents.name: Project Manager
agents.description: Breaks features into branches, writes user stories, and maintains scope.

agents.name: Architect
agents.description: Evaluates architecture decisions, data models, dependencies, and security.

agents.name: Senior Engineer
agents.description: Writes production-quality Angular/TypeScript code with tests and clean commits.

agents.name: UX Designer
agents.description: Designs accessible, mobile-first UI with clear component and interaction patterns.

agents.name: Orchestrator
agents.description: Coordinates all agents — breaks goals into tasks, routes work, tracks progress, and reports status.

agents.name: QA Engineer
agents.description: Designs and executes test strategies — unit, integration, and E2E. Validates acceptance criteria and triages bugs.

agents.name: Code Reviewer
agents.description: Reviews PRs for Angular best practices, TypeScript correctness, performance, security, and accessibility.

agents.name: DevOps Engineer
agents.description: Manages CI/CD pipelines, Firebase deployments, GitHub Actions, environment config, and rollback strategies.

agents.name: Git Manager
agents.description: Handles day-to-day git operations — status, branching, commits, stash, and conflict resolution across repos.

agents.name: Researcher
agents.description: Monitors Angular/Firebase releases, security advisories, and evaluates new libraries and performance techniques.

agents.name: Technical Writer
agents.description: Writes and maintains READMEs, component docs, API references, and changelogs.

agents.name: Security Specialist
agents.description: Runs security scans, reviews Firestore rules, checks dependencies, and enforces OWASP compliance.
